proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B H hA hB hH hle
  exact EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mul_dist_eq_power_of_radius_le_dist_center (s.radius_nonneg_of_mem hA) hH hA hB hle
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B H : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → H ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → s.radius ≤ dist H s.center → dist H A * dist H B = dist H s.center ^ 2 - s.radius ^ 2
